shortDescription: Manage multiple Docker Compose fragment files.

options.name: base_directory
options.description: The target directory where all Docker Compose fragment files will be stored. Each fragment will be saved as a C(.conf) file under this directory.

options.name: networks
options.description: A list of network configuration dictionaries to be managed. Each item must contain at least a C(name) key. Each entry can also include a C(state) key to control whether the fragment is present or absent.

options.name: services
options.description: A list of Docker service definitions to be managed as Compose fragments. Each item represents a single service stored as an independent Compose C(.conf) file.

options.name: volumes
options.description: A list of Docker volume definitions to be managed as Compose fragments. Each item represents a single volume stored as a Compose C(.conf) file.
